T: Last man in New York. Last tin of peaches.
D: A scientist and his German shepherd may be the last people left in New York.
P: Serve the snacks when Robert and Sam go hunting deer in Times Square.
S: from the corn he grows in the park
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C, salted, with a fresh corn and tomato salsa.
Tinned peaches drained and grilled cut-side down until caramelised, a spoon of Greek yoghurt and honey.
M: charred on the grill, butter and salt
Corn charred over hot coals, brushed with butter mixed with chilli and lime zest, rolled in grated parmesan.
cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York
Sirloin seared in a hot pan, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, rested and sliced. Keep a plain piece for the dog.
W: rationed sweets in a locked-down house
Creamy baked rice pudding with nutmeg, made from what keeps in the pantry. Stir 100g short grain rice, 60g sugar and 1L milk in a buttered dish with a strip of lemon peel.
K: the bottle Robert keeps in the lab
Bourbon neat in a tumbler, or bottled water for the long night.

edition.tagline: Last man in New York. Last tin of peaches.
edition.cue: Serve the snacks when Robert and Sam go hunting deer in Times Square.

s.note: from the corn he grows in the park
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix with 3 diced tomatoes, chopped coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Serve the salsa in a bowl with the chips.
Drain 2 tins of peach halves and pat dry. Grill cut side down in a hot pan for 3 minutes until caramelised. Serve warm with a spoon of Greek yoghurt mixed with honey, about 200g yoghurt in total.

m.note: cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York
m.how: Season 4 sirloins well and sear in a hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for a minute. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Keep a plain unseasoned piece aside for the dog.

w.note: rationed sweets in a locked-down house
w.how: Stir 100g short grain rice, 60g sugar and 1L milk in a buttered dish with a strip of lemon peel. Grate over nutmeg and bake at 150C for 2 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes.

d.note: the bottle Robert keeps in the lab
d.how: Pour 45ml bourbon neat into each of four tumblers. Put a few bottles of spring water on the bench for anyone who wants to keep a clear head. Lock the door before you pour.
